info.title: Freya Bank voice assistant: statement and debt services (mock)
info.description: Our mock of the seven services of the bank's service contract of 1 October 2026. Every service is POST with {data, call}; every answer has result, successful ones also data.

post.summary: Returns the customer's cards the assistant may talk about. The first service of every call.
post.description: Returns the customer's cards the assistant may talk about. The first service of every call.

customerNo.description: The customer number the phone menu handed over with the call (8 digits).

call.description: Call metadata the bank logs; nothing depends on it.

cards.description: Only active cards. Two cards can have the same productName and the same cardNumberLast4.

productName.description: free text from the card system

result.description: Present in every answer. Success = HTTP 200 and returnCode "1". Anything else is an error; an error answer has no data object. messageText is for logs and is not read to the caller.
